summary: Full regression + v3 feature validation for Astitva (logo refresh, new color palette, Market Intelligence page w/ Google News RSS, extended Contact form, redesigned Footer w/ CTA strip, 6-pillar Why-Astitva). 43/43 backend pytest pass including 9 new tests covering /api/news/* and extended /api/leads fields. Frontend: Market Intelligence page renders all 8 sections, 36 news cards open in new tab (target=_blank), new ASTITTVA logo URL loads in header + footer, mobile drawer includes MARKET INTELLIGENCE, Contact form submits with all 5 new fields and persists end-to-end. Copper #C47B3A button color and #050505 charcoal bg confirmed. No horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile (390x844).
action_items: Cosmetic: the review request expected MarketIntelligencePage section data-testids like 'mi-hero','mi-snapshot','mi-trending' etc., but the implementation uses 'market-intelligence-page','market-snapshot','trending-news','local-news','india-news','global-news','investment-insights','expansion-tracker'. All sections render correctly — only the naming differs. Optional rename for consistency with the spec, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: news_service.py uses requests.get inside asyncio.to_thread which is fine, but a shared aiohttp client with connection pooling would be more efficient under load.

fetch_topic falls back to stale cache only when fresh fetch returns empty AND prior cache existed; if neither exists the endpoint returns []. Acceptable per spec but consider returning a flag like {stale:true} for the frontend to surface a 'no data' state instead of blank grids.
MarketIntelligencePage data-testid naming is inconsistent with the requested 'mi-*' prefix in the review request; align for predictability in regression suites.
Both Header and Footer hardcode the customer-assets logo URL — extract to a single constant (e.g., src/lib/brand.js) so a future logo swap is a one-line change.

/api/news/trending and /api/news/group/* don't expose Cache-Control headers; frontend cannot leverage browser caching even though backend caches 6h. Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 to reduce server hits.
LeadIn now has 11 optional string fields — consider a nested 'preferences' sub-model for cleaner schema and admin UI grouping.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 lead via UI flow (TEST_UI_User_*) — verified preferred_locality='New Town', investment_purpose='Self-Use', property_type='Apartment', budget='Under ₹50 L', timeline='Immediate (< 30 days)' persisted via GET /api/admin/leads. Backend tests create + clean their own TEST_* leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 43 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover health, auth (login/me/refresh), properties public+admin CRUD, leads (incl. budget + extended fields preferred_locality/investment_purpose/property_type/timeline), users RBAC, upload+serve, and News (topics/trending/group local|india|global/group invalid 400/refresh auth+admin). Google News RSS first fetch ~5-15s; subsequent calls hit Mongo cache (TTL 6h, collection 'news_cache'). Frontend MI page data-testids: market-intelligence-page, market-snapshot, snapshot-card-{0..5}, signal-{i}, trending-news, local-news, india-news, global-news, investment-insights, expansion-tracker, news-card-{idx}. Contact form testids: contact-name, contact-email, contact-phone, contact-locality, contact-purpose, contact-property-type, contact-budget, contact-timeline, contact-message, contact-submit, contact-thank-you, contact-error. Contact selects are NATIVE HTML <select> elements — use page.select_option(testid, label=...). Hamburger drawer (mobile) confirms 'MARKET INTELLIGENCE' nav item.
verified_data_testids: news-card-* (36 instances on page, target=_blank, http link)
